findings.title: Team screen silently truncates at 1,000 staff rows (newest hidden); HANDOFF records it as test pollution only
findings.evidence: loadDirectory() calls supabase.rpc('staff_directory') with no range/pagination; the function orders `order by s.created_at` (supabase/migrations/20260925090000_audit_and_staff_directory.sql:76) and supabase/config.toml sets max_rows = 1000, so PostgREST drops every row past the 1000th: the newest invite. PLANS/HANDOFF.md:32 calls this test pollution and auth.spec:63 asserts the invited email is visible.
findings.impact: At >1000 staff rows the team screen shows a stale list with no notice and a fresh invite looks as if it failed; bounded (a studio team is tiny) but the UI has no truncation signal and the record misclassifies a product limit as a test artefact.
findings.proposed_fix: Order staff_directory by created_at desc, or page the rpc (.range) in TeamView; at minimum document the limit in HANDOFF as a product limit.
